capabilities: choose the bullet list character in settings
toggle or format bullet lists with the selected character via a hotkey
add the toggle command to the mobile toolbar
extras: README has typos ('Brownse', 'ewtra') and its demo screenshots are not shown in the text version.
problem: Obsidian always creates bullet lists with '-' and offers no setting to use '*' or '+' instead.
summary: List-character picker that lets you choose '-', '*' or '+' as the bullet character and toggle or format bullet lists with a hotkey.
